subject: Song of Time
text: The Song of Time is first taught by Zelda when Link obtains the Ocarina of Time, using the sequence C-Right, A Button, C-Down, C-Right, A Button, C-Down.

evidence.quote:
Song of Time
First Found: Hyrule Field
Sequence: C-Right, A Button, C-Down, C-Right, A Button, C-Down

First taught to you by Zelda when you first obtain the Ocarina of Time

subject: Song of Time
text: The Song of Time is used initially to open the Door of Time in the Temple of Time, and later as Adult Link to interact with Blocks of Time.

evidence.quote: the Song of Time is initially used to open the Door of Time in the Temple of Time. Later on, as Adult Link, the Song of Time is used to interact with Blocks of Time.

subject: Song of Storms
text: The Song of Storms is taught to Adult Link in the Windmill by the Organ Grinder with the sequence A Button, C-Down, C-Up, A Button, C-Down, C-Up.

evidence.quote:
Song of Storms
First Found: Kakariko Village - Windmill (Adult Link)
Sequence: A Button, C-Down, C-Up, A Button, C-Down, C-Up

Taught to Adult Link in the Windmill by the Organ Grinder

subject: Song of Storms
text: The Song of Storms is required to gain access to the Bottom of the Well dungeon as Young Link.

evidence.quote: The Song of Storms is required to gain access to the Bottom of the Well dungeon as Young Link, but this is it's only required used.

subject: Song of Storms
text: The Song of Storms can optionally fill the dried up oasis in Desert Colossus, and its storm eases crossing the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote: It can optionally be used to fill the dried up oasis in Desert Colossus, and the storm it creates makes crossing the Haunted Wasteland easier.

subject: Minuet of Forest
text: The Minuet of Forest is taught to Link by Sheik at the back of the Sacred Forest Meadow using the sequence A Button, C-Up, C-Left, C-Right, C-Left, C-Right.

evidence.quote:
Minuet of Forest
First Found: Sacred Forest Meadow
Sequence: A Button, C-Up, C-Left, C-Right, C-Left, C-Right

The first of the magical transportation songs that Adult Link learns, the Minuet of Forest is taught to Link by Sheik when he reaches the back of the Sacred Forest Meadow.

subject: Minuet of Forest
text: The Minuet of Forest transports Link to the Sacred Forest Meadow at any time, providing access to the Forest Temple and a nearby Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: The Minuet transports Link (Young or Adult) to the Sacred Forest Meadow at any time, giving easy access to the Forest Temple and a nearby Fairy Fountain.

subject: Bolero of Fire
text: The Bolero of Fire is taught to Link by Sheik at the bottom level of Death Mountain Crater via the door in Darunia's Chamber, using the sequence C-Down, A Button, C-Down, A Button, C-Right, C-Down, C-Right, C-Down.

evidence.quote:
Bolero of Fire
First Found: Death Mountain Crater
Sequence: C-Down, A Button, C-Down, A Button, C-Right, C-Down, C-Right, C-Down

The third of the magical transportation songs that Adult Link can learn, the Bolero of Fire is taught to Link by Sheik when he reaches the bottom level of the Death Mountain Crater (use the door in Darunia's Chamber).

subject: Bolero of Fire
text: The Bolero of Fire transports Link to Death Mountain Crater, granting access to the Fire Temple and allowing Young Link to reach a hidden soft soil earth patch.

evidence.quote: The Bolero transports Link (Young or Adult) to Death Mountain Crater, giving easy access to the Fire Temple.  Young Link must use the transportation song to reach one of the most cunningly hidden earth patches in the game.

subject: Serenade of Water
text: The Serenade of Water is taught to Link by Sheik after obtaining the Iron Boots in the Ice Cavern, using the sequence A Button, C-Down, C-Right, C-Right, C-Left.

evidence.quote:
Serenade of Water
First Found: Ice Cavern
Sequence: A Button, C-Down, C-Right, C-Right, C-Left

The fourth of the magical transportation songs that Adult Link can learn, the Serenade of Fire is taught to Link by Sheik after he obtains the Iron Boots from the Ice Cavern.

subject: Serenade of Water
text: The Serenade of Water transports Link to Lake Hylia, providing easy access to the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: The Serenade transports Link (Young or Adult) to Lake Hylia, giving easy access to the Water Temple.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: The Requiem of Spirit is taught by Sheik after Link enters, leaves the Spirit Temple, and returns to the Desert Colossus, using the sequence A Button, C-Down, A Button, C-Right, C-Down, A Button.

evidence.quote:
Requiem of Spirit
First Found: Desert Colossus
Sequence: A Button, C-Down, A Button, C-Right, C-Down, A Button

The sixth of the magical transportation songs that Adult Link can learn, the Requiem of Spirit is taught to Link by Sheik after he enters, and then leaves the Spirit Temple and returns to the Desert Colossus.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: The Requiem of Spirit transports Link to Desert Colossus, which Young Link must use to access the Spirit Temple because the Gerudo Thieves block the bridge into the Fortress.

evidence.quote: The Requiem transports Link (Young or Adult) to the Desert Colossus, giving easy access to the Spirit Temple.  Young Link must use this song to access to the Spirit Temple, since the Gerudo Thieves won't let him cross the bridge into the Fortress.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: The Nocturne of Shadow is taught by Sheik after Adult Link finishes the Forest, Fire, and Water Temples and enters Kakariko Village, using the sequence C-Left, C-Right, C-Right, A Button, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down.

evidence.quote:
Nocturne of Shadow
First Found: Kakariko Village
Sequence: C-Left, C-Right, C-Right, A Button, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down

The fifth of the magical transportation songs that Adult Link can learn, the Nocturne of Shadow is taught to Link by Sheik after he finishes the Forest, Fire and Water Temple and enters Kakariko Village.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: The Nocturne of Shadow transports Link to the high ledge in Kakariko Graveyard, which is the only way to reach the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote: The Nocturne transports Link (Young or Adult) to the high ledge in Kakariko Graveyard.  This is the ONLY way to reach the Shadow Temple.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: The Prelude of Light is taught by Sheik after completing the Forest Temple and returning to the Temple of Time, using the sequence C-Up, C-Right, C-Up, C-Right, C-Left, C-Up.

evidence.quote:
Prelude of Light
First Found: The Temple of Time
Sequence: C-Up, C-Right, C-Up, C-Right, C-Left, C-Up

The second of the magical transportation songs that Adult Link can learn, the Prelude of Light is taught to Link by Sheik after he finishes the Forest Temple and returns to the Temple of Time.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: The Prelude of Light transports Link to the Temple of Time, enabling quick travel between Adulthood and Childhood.

evidence.quote: The Prelude of Light transports Link (Young or Adult) to the Temple of Time, making travel between Adulthood and Childhood a quick and painless task.

subject: The Scarecrow's Song
text: The Scarecrow's Song is taught by the player as Young Link to a scarecrow in Lake Hylia using an custom eight-note melody containing at least two different notes.

evidence.quote: A hidden song, the Scarecrow's Song is taught by the player to one of the scarecrows in Lake Hylia by Young Link.  You can make up any song you like, with a few requirements: it can't be any of the other songs in the game, it must contain eight notes, and it must contain at least two different notes.

subject: Pierre the Scarecrow
text: Playing the same Scarecrow's Song to the scarecrow in Lake Hylia as Adult Link allows Link to summon Pierre the Scarecrow around Hyrule as a makeshift Hookshot target.

evidence.quote: Once you have become Adult Link, return to Lake Hylia and play the Scarecrow the same song you played as Young Link.  The Scarecrow will "remember" the Song, and the Scarecrow's Song can now be played at various places around Hyrule to make Pierre the Scarecrow appear.  Pierre can be used as a makeshift Hookshot target.

subject: Kokiri Training Ground
text: The Kokiri Sword is found in the back of the Kokiri Training Ground and is required by Mido before meeting the Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: Found in the back of the Kokiri Training Ground, the Kokiri Sword is one of the items that Mido requires you to find before you can meet the Deku Tree.

subject: Master Sword
text: The Master Sword is found in the Temple of Time and serves as the main weapon wielded by Adult Link, pairing with the Hylian or Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote:
Master Sword
First Found: The Temple of Time
Used By: Adult Link...The main weapon used by Adult Link, it is preferred for most of the basic fights thanks to the fact that you can pair it with the Hylian or Mirror Shield.

subject: Giant's Knife
text: The Giant's Knife is sold for two hundred rupees by Biggoron in the back of Goron City, but it is fragile and breaks upon use.

evidence.quote: Purchased for two hundred rupees from the Biggoron stashed away in the back of Goron City, the Giant's Knife is poorly crafted and will break when used.

subject: Biggoron Sword
text: The Biggoron Sword is obtained on Death Mountain Trail as the ultimate reward for completing the Biggoron Sword Trading Sidequest.

evidence.quote:
Biggoron Sword
First Found: Death Mountain Trail
Used By: Adult Link

The ultimate reward for finishing the Biggoron Sword Trading Sidequest, the Biggoron Sword is identical to the Giant's Knife.

subject: Biggoron Sword
text: The Biggoron Sword does not shatter when used, but it is so large that Link cannot wield a shield simultaneously.

evidence.quote: Only the Biggoron who crafts this one is actually a competent swordsmith, so it won't shatter when used...The Biggoron Sword is so large that a shield cannot be wielded while using it.

subject: Deku Shield
text: The Deku Shield can be purchased from the Kokiri Shop for forty rupees and is required by Mido to visit the Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: Purchased from the Kokiri Shop for forty rupees, this is the other item that Mido requires you to get before he'll let you visit the Deku Tree.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: The Hylian Shield can be found underneath a gravestone in Kakariko Graveyard, or bought later from the Bazaar in Hyrule Castle Market and Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: One of your first opportunities to acquire the shield is underneath one of the gravestones in Kakariko Graveyard, though you can also purchase it from the Bazaar in Hyrule Castle Market and Kakariko Village later on.

subject: Like-Likes
text: Like-Likes can easily steal Hylian Shields from Link during combat.

evidence.quote: Hylian Shields are easily stolen by Like-Likes, so be careful when combating these foes.
